steps.text: jei-pinyin-search: open the inventory so JEI's ingredient overlay is up (the harness's throwaway level is creative, so the inventory bind opens the creative inventory)

jei-pinyin-search: focus JEI's search bar with a mouse click. JEI's field is not a widget of the open screen (measured on this row's 1.18.2 forge sibling: the live children of CreativeModeInventoryScreen are one vanilla EditBox, that screen's own search box), so a click dispatched at the screen never reaches it; click_mouse presses and releases through the client's own mouse handler, which is where Forge raises the screen mouse events JEI's overlay listens to. 1180,703 is the bar's centre — the point measured on that sibling (the GUI space is 1280x720 at the pinned GUI scale 2, so a 2560x1440 framebuffer pixel is GUI(pixel/2)); this scenario's own assertion is what confirms it here, and it needs re-measuring if JEI's layout changes
jei-pinyin-search: type the pinyin of 石头 (shi tou) one character at a time
